# System invariants

[English](invariants.md) | [日本語](../ja/invariants.md) | [Français](../fr/invariants.md) | [中文](../invariants.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

These constraints apply to Core persistence and execution paths. Each lists its scope, implementation entry points, and validation cases. Model prompts express working conventions; host code enforces these constraints.

1. **One writer per data directory.** The lock-owning helper appends to the journal; a closed Store or one that has lost ownership rejects commits.
   Implementation: [Store.commit](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store.ts), [store-lock](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store-lock.ts). Tests: [store-ownership](../../test_case/offline/issue19/store-ownership.test.ts), `live owner excludes another opener`.

2. **Install transaction state only after durability acknowledgment.** Records, events, and receipts are validated as a whole and enter memory together after an fsync ACK matching request ID, sequence, and digest. If acknowledgment is lost, reopen and reconcile with the journal.
   Implementation: [Store.commit / stage](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store.ts), [store-channel](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store-channel.mjs). Tests: [transport](../../test_case/offline/issue24/transport.test.ts), `invalid ... ACK never installs, but reopen recovers fsynced transaction`.

3. **CAS references identify fixed bytes.** Commit/replay checks reference paths, regular files, and lengths; mutation snapshots verify hashes. Content reads verify full SHA-256; same-length corruption is detected on read or full verification.
   Implementation: [Store.read / stage](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store.ts). Tests: [store](../../test_case/offline/issue24/store.test.ts), `reference metadata rejects missing, truncated and symlink objects; reads reject same-length corruption`.

4. **Persist successful model responses before executing tools.** Main-session and task durableStream hand off to Agent only after the full successful response is durable; recovery reuses saved successful responses.
   Implementation: [durableStream](../../src/pi_secretary/src/transport.ts). Tests: [crash](../../test_case/offline/issue19/crash.test.ts), `real SIGKILL at ... durable boundary preserves model work and attempt count`; [Task recovery](../../test_case/offline/issue18/model-crash.test.ts).

5. **Count model retries per logical call.** A logical call allows at most three sends; restart retains used attempts. Transient transport errors back off; cancellation, authentication, and local capacity errors terminate separately.
   Implementation: [durableStream](../../src/pi_secretary/src/transport.ts), [transportFailure](../../src/pi_secretary/src/model-retry.ts). Tests: [retry](../../test_case/offline/issue19/retry.test.ts), `saved failure diagnostics permit exactly three sends and success replay`.

6. **Approval binds the current display and revision.** decide checks expected_revision/display_hash. Approve-and-remember commits authorization and a constrained rule atomically; dispatch revalidates rules and resources.
   Implementation: [Authorization.decide / dispatch / remember](../../src/pi_secretary/src/authorization.ts). Tests: [API](../../test_case/offline/issue8/api.test.ts), `approval exact display/CAS`; [authorization](../../test_case/offline/issue17/authorization.test.ts), `REM-04 commit failure publishes neither approval nor remembered rule`, `REM-01/03/04: approve and remember is atomic, replayable, prefix constrained and disables at dispatch`.

7. **Unknown external effects await verification or resolution.** RESULT_UNKNOWN shell/program operations are never replayed automatically. File writes can be verified; the owner can resolve APPLIED/NOT_APPLIED/PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED. Effect finalization and confirmed controlled-process termination jointly determine execution finalization.
   Implementation: [Authorization.resolve](../../src/pi_secretary/src/authorization.ts), [settleUnknownExecution](../../src/pi_secretary/src/execution-recovery.ts). Tests: [resolution](../../test_case/offline/issue18/resolution.test.ts), `resolution cannot release an unconfirmed process`; [shell](../../test_case/offline/runtime/shell.test.ts), `timeout preserves uncertainty and never replays partial shell effects`.

8. **Persist process identity before allowing startup.** A ready shell/program wrapper waits for a start frame. Cancellation before start records no effect; a missing result frame records an unknown effect.
   Implementation: [launchProcess](../../src/pi_secretary/src/process-control.ts), [process-runner](../../src/pi_secretary/src/process-runner.py). Tests: [process-protocol](../../test_case/offline/issue18/process-protocol.test.ts), `cancellation after ready but before start has no effect`, `wrapper exit without a result frame is unknown`.

9. **Execution roots are fixed at creation.** Scope changes affect future executions. Bound roots and old roots still occupying slots remain in conflict checks; slot-occupying executions of one DIRECTORY advance serially.
   Implementation: [Scopes / occupies](../../src/pi_secretary/src/scopes.ts), [execution-runner](../../src/pi_secretary/src/execution-runner.ts). Tests: [scopes](../../test_case/offline/issue16/scopes.test.ts), `Execution freezes root`; [dispatch](../../test_case/offline/issue16/dispatch.test.ts), `run acquires synchronously`.

10. **File tools validate paths against the bound root.** read, write, and submit_result artifacts use safePath/relativePath to reject absolute paths, escaping segments, and symlink paths; shell/program runs with local-user privileges.
    Implementation: [executor-tools](../../src/pi_secretary/src/executor-tools.ts), [safePath](../../src/pi_secretary/src/effects.ts), [relativePath](../../src/pi_secretary/src/scopes.ts). Tests: [workspace](../../test_case/offline/issue16/workspace.test.ts), `notes are bounded UTF-8 data, unsafe paths fail`, `approved write waits through unsafe root replacement`; [scopes](../../test_case/offline/issue16/scopes.test.ts) `DIRECTORY rejects overlapping roots, data roots, symlink parents and unsafe notes` covers escape and symlink rejection in the shared validator; tool integration is checked at the call sites above.

11. **Command IDs bind original intent.** A request_id with the same owner, path, and normalized body returns its original receipt; conflicting submissions are rejected. Short-command admission and first domain change share a transaction; interrupted long commands retain UNKNOWN for reconciliation.
    Implementation: [ApplicationService](../../src/pi_secretary/src/application-service.ts). Tests: [API](../../test_case/offline/issue8/api.test.ts), `two clients: concurrent dedup, cross-command conflict`; [admission-boundary](../../test_case/offline/issue8/admission-boundary.test.ts).

12. **Summary success and commitment extraction commit separately.** Extraction failure retains frozen sources and segment progress; retries merge into the current commitment ledger while preserving resolved states.
    Implementation: [memory-summary](../../src/pi_secretary/src/memory-summary.ts), [memory-extraction](../../src/pi_secretary/src/memory-extraction.ts). Tests: [retry](../../test_case/offline/issue19/retry.test.ts), `summary coverage and Settings commit survive extraction failure`.

13. **Removing old inputs requires successful coverage and a search watermark.** Only uniquely identified, fully covered originals outside current-turn and tool-protocol protection zones may be removed. An unavailable index preserves prior removal receipts and pauses new removals.
    Implementation: [selectInputProjection](../../src/pi_secretary/src/input-projection.ts). Tests: [projection](../../test_case/offline/issue28/projection.test.ts), `FAILED/STALE, uncovered and current Inputs survive`, `unavailable search freezes previous coverage`; [settings](../../test_case/offline/issue28/settings.test.ts), `in-flight search outage after World commit`.

14. **Settings bridges both stores through receipts.** World batches atomically commit facts and receipts. Local active instructions, Consciousness, Context, and APPLIED commit together; retries first identify already committed batches.
    Implementation: [Settings](../../src/pi_secretary/src/settings.ts), [World](../../src/pi_secretary/src/world.ts). Tests: [settings](../../test_case/offline/runtime/settings.test.ts), `draft is durable and inactive; application summarizes both reference sets`; in the same file, `database commit followed by SIGKILL restores the same batch`.

15. **Durable sync cursors identify a journal prefix.** A cursor binds owner, sequence, and digest and survives restart; divergent or truncated history requires reloading. changes delivers whole transactions; oversized transactions become category invalidations.
    Implementation: [SyncService.position / changes](../../src/pi_secretary/src/sync-service.ts). Tests: [cursor](../../test_case/offline/issue9/cursor.test.ts), `same identity restored backup rejects divergent digest`; [changes](../../test_case/offline/issue9/changes.test.ts), `oversized complete transaction falls back`.

16. **Queue each wakeup only once.** FIRED and the unique TIMER Input commit together. Only PENDING can be cancelled. TIMER preserves its source identity and follows existing main-session recovery and authorization rules.
    Implementation: [Wakeups.fireDue / cancel](../../src/pi_secretary/src/wakeups.ts). Tests: [wakeups](../../test_case/offline/issue23/wakeups.test.ts), `wakeup atomically queues one sourced TIMER input`; [Provenance protection](../../test_case/offline/issue23/host.test.ts).

17. **Record channel acceptance, presentation, and read separately.** Push retries stay within four attempts; a crash after acceptance but before saving the result can duplicate delivery. presented deduplicates by notification/client; read_at retains the first global timestamp.
    Implementation: [Pushes.tick](../../src/pi_secretary/src/push-service.ts), [Notifications](../../src/pi_secretary/src/notification-service.ts). Tests: [push](../../test_case/offline/issue22/push.test.ts), `fourth interrupted attempt is terminal`; [notifications](../../test_case/offline/issue9/notifications.test.ts), `presented event and admission are atomic, read is global and separate`.

18. **Managed state changes must match transition tables.** Store commit and replay check before/after states of Execution, Operation, and Input. Same-state updates and schema-valid initial snapshots are handled separately; domain guards still check business preconditions.
    Implementation: [validateStateTransition](../../src/pi_secretary/src/state-transitions.ts), [Store.stage](../../src/pi_secretary/src/store.ts). Tests: [transitions](../../test_case/offline/issue25/transitions.test.ts), `every state pair`, `replay rejects a correctly hashed journal carrying an illegal transition`.

Image attachments reserve capacity in a separate import ledger and bind immutable CAS to Inputs; see the [attachment guide](api/v1/attachments.md) for formats, budgets, residency and withdrawal.
